source_traced_resolution.fact: Kernel::postLoad looks up symbolName() in the loaded HSA executable, queries HSA_EXECUTABLE_SYMBOL_INFO_KERNEL_OBJECT, and stores the result as kernelCodeHandle_.
The inspected ROCr loader returns the loaded symbol address for HSA_EXECUTABLE_SYMBOL_INFO_KERNEL_OBJECT after checking that the symbol is loaded.
For the inspected code-object-v3 .kd path, the loader creates the kernel descriptor from the loaded .kd symbol address.
